REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION: - `gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node, parent?)`: - For `SwitchCase`: scans up to PRE_COMMENT_OFFSET lines above the case for comment lines and joins them. - For other nodes: uses `sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node)` and maps comments to values. - traceability.notes: Story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS is fully implemented. The `require-branch-annotation` rule exists, is integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict configs, and enforces `@story`/`@req` on significant branch types (if/switch/try-catch/loops), with configurable branch types, nested-branch handling, formatter-aware catch and else-if behavior, and auto-fix support. Helpers implement branch significance criteria, comment association, and annotation parsing in line with the requirements. Dedicated unit, rule, and performance tests explicitly reference this story and its requirement IDs (REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION, REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION, REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING, REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA, REQ-NESTED-HANDLING, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION), and all pass under Jest. Rule documentation in docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md provides examples, configuration details, and invalid-config behavior matching the implementation. Taken together, this satisfies all acceptance criteria and definition-of-done items for this story.
